title: The Face of Fear
author: Dean Koontz
note: conf=0.95; 1977 suspense/horror novel, originally published under Koontz's pseudonym Brian Coffey (Bobbs-Merrill, ISBN 0-672-52312-4); later reissued under Dean Koontz's own name. ISBN 9781440620614 (144062061X) corresponds to a Kindle edition of this work per Goodreads editions list. Standalone: protagonist Graham Harris appears in no other novel, and the only Koontz-as-Coffey series (Mike Tucker: Blood Risk, Surrounded, The Wall of Masks) does not include this title.
